newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police suspect extortion in rail sabotage.
newsitem.headline: German police suspect extortion in rail sabotage.

text.p: Police said on Thursday suspected extortionists carried out an overnight attack on a goods train in central Germany causing around 50,000 marks' damage.
The attackers sawed through a pylon beside the track, causing it to crash down on a passing train. No one was injured.
Police said they found a letter, headed "extortion note to German railways", but declined to give any further details.

Anti-nuclear activists have carried out acts of sabotage on German railways to protest about the transfer of nuclear waste for reprocessing but police said they did not believe the militants were behind the latest attack.
